content_sections.heading: CNMC Kolkata Medical Officer Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CNMC Kolkata Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CNMC Kolkata Medical Officer Job 2026 Notification PDF

CNMC Kolkata Medical Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The Doctor has a minimum Qualification of MBBS with valid registration from the medical council. Those with MD Psychiatry/ Diploma in Psychiatry Medicine (DPM) will be preferred.

CNMC Kolkata Medical Officer Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the CNMC Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the Calcutta National Medical College & Hospital Recruitment 2026 is Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Medical Officer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 10 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is MBBS with a valid registration from the medical council. MD Psychiatry or Diploma in Psychiatry Medicine (DPM) is preferred.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Officer post is 65 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 72,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC, SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification and an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Calcutta National Medical College & Hospital located?
faq.answer: Calcutta National Medical College & Hospital is located in Kolkata, West Bengal, with the pincode 700014.
